text: {"lessons":["A short run of gains or losses is not enough to judge a stock; avoid reacting to recent price moves alone.","Set a clear investment thesis and risk-based exit plan; neither my average cost nor a rebound should dictate a sale or repurchase.","Size positions deliberately and preserve cash: adding to Stock C after it rose and returning to Stock D both increased exposure, so each trade should earn its place against the goal of beating the market."]}
